components.name: Cloud Action Button
components.description: Botao circular de acao com superficie clara, foco Sky e elevacao curta.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" aria-label="Adicionar referencia"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display:grid; place-items:center; width:72px; height:72px; border:2px solid #bae6fd; border-radius:50%; color:#0c4a6e; background:#f0f9ff; box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(5,45,70,.22); cursor:pointer; transition:color 220ms ease-out, background-color 220ms ease-out, border-color 220ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color:#15803d; background:#f0fdf4; border-color:#bbf7d0; box-shadow:0 15px 26px rgba(5,45,70,.27); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #0369a1; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Popover contextual Sky para acoes ancoradas no grupo da nuvem.
components.css: .ds-dropdown-menu { width:214px; padding:10px; border:1px solid #bae6fd; border-radius:18px; color:#0c4a6e; background:#f0f9ff; box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(5,45,70,.25); animation:ds-dropdown-open 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-dropdown-item { display:flex; width:100%; min-height:40px; align-items:center; border:0; border-radius:11px; color:#0c4a6e; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-dropdown-item:hover { background:#e0f2fe; } @keyframes ds-dropdown-open { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px) scale(.94); } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) scale(1); } }

components.name: Dropdown Menu Item
components.description: Item de menu com icone Lucide, label e variante destructive opcional.
components.css: .ds-dropdown-item { gap:10px; padding:0 10px; font:650 .84rem/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-dropdown-item svg { width:17px; height:17px; flex:0 0 auto; color:#0369a1; } .ds-dropdown-item--destructive { color:#b91c1c; } .ds-dropdown-item--destructive:hover { color:#b91c1c; background:#fef2f2; } .ds-dropdown-item--destructive:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b91c1c; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview: Cloudy e um espaco pessoal leve e visual. O workspace profundo em Sky deixa a nuvem 3D e a proxima acao no centro, enquanto superficies quase brancas criam contraste e clareza. Controles compactos se agrupam como uma pequena nuvem fisica.

rules.name: Uma unica linguagem de acao
rules.body: Reutilize IconButton e DropdownMenu antes de criar estilos locais.

rules.name: Movimento com proposito
rules.body: Animacoes explicam entrada, foco ou resposta e respeitam reduced motion.

dos: Use tokens Sky, Green e Red
Mantenha alvos de toque com pelo menos 44px
Use icones Lucide com labels acessiveis
donts: Nao crie menus com sombras proprias
Nao use glassmorphism ou gradientes de texto
Nao desloque itens de menu no hover
